githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.0 expands messaging, direct messages, calls, unread tracking, notifications, attachments, and native macOS presentation. It also introduces signed Sparkle update support, sanitized diagnostics, and a rebuilt native message timeline.

## Messaging and timelines
- Rebuilt message timelines with Core Text and AppKit layout, restoring rich content, Components V2, Markdown, spoilers, selection, scrolling, loading, unread positioning, and thread behavior.
- Added optimistic messages while sending.
- Improved reaction reconciliation and restored visible reaction avatar previews.
- Added channel and thread context menus.
- Improved forum previews, unread state, and post presentation.
- Added support for dynamic component choices and aligned Components V2 section accessories.
- Restricted message-link activation, trusted only Discord-linked images, and required current reaction hit targets.
- Added Escape handling for canceling inline edits.

## Attachments and media
- Added window-wide channel and thread drop targets, staged attachment previews, metadata editing, spoiler controls, and Shift-drop immediate upload.
- Enforced the ten-file attachment limit before production requests while keeping draft URLs and metadata synchronized.
- Improved media caching and timeline memory use, including cancellation of obsolete media requests.
- Preserved transparency in avatar images and restored animated decorated timeline avatars.

## Direct messages and calls
- Added a direct-message inbox, private conversation routing, recipient profiles, composer behavior, optimistic sending, presence, and custom status display.
- Added DM and group-DM voice-call state, draggable call presentation, ringing and missed-call UI, and participant reconciliation.
- Deduplicated private-call actions and improved reconciliation when calls move.
- Matched DM profile presentation to macOS window corners.

## Unread state and notifications
- Added account-scoped unread and mention state, view-gated acknowledgements, sidebar indicators, timeline affordances, and native macOS notification scaffolding.
- Added Discord sound effects and notifications.
- Kept visible New dividers stable during background acknowledgements, advancing them after an explicit Escape action or successful send.
- Fixed unread timeline positioning and pagination, refreshed unread projections from snapshots, and prevented a duplicate READY read-state crash.
- Added protocol contracts and offline coverage around READY and live updates, acknowledgement reconciliation, notification policy, aggregation, deep links, and foreground presentation. Live Discord parity and notification polish remain incomplete.

## Interface and visual polish
- Refined sidebar window chrome and fixed native macOS toolbar and inspector layout.
- Applied native concentric geometry throughout the app.
- Matched Discord collectible nameplate presentation, including hover-only animation for APNG artwork.
- Added hover-only animation for animated server icons.
- Matched Discord linked-emoji presentation.
- Removed the Quick Switcher.

## Updates and diagnostics
- Integrated signed Sparkle update support with canonical-bundle gating, menu and Settings controls, persisted preferences, sandbox entitlements, appcast automation, and validation.
- Derived bundle, feed, DMG, and archive metadata from release tags and finalized the release setup.
- Bundled third-party notices.
- Added bounded, session-local diagnostics for REST, attachments, authentication, Gateway, voice Gateway, and remote-auth metadata, with export and clear controls in Settings.
- Diagnostics allowlist protocol metadata while discarding credentials, cookies, challenges, user-authored text, names, filenames, and URLs before retention.

## Project maintenance
- Added a SakuraCord brand asset library and refreshed the README, project overview, documentation, workflows, and Discord protocol research guidance.
- Added pre-push code-quality enforcement and updated the CI checkout action runtime.
- Kept command-copy tests and media benchmarks isolated from the system clipboard and network.
- Refactored native timeline state and removed unused rich-message views.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.0.2...v0.1.0](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.0.2...v0.1.0)
